glossary.ja: クインシィ・バロンズゥ
glossary.role: Baronz that evolved from Quincy's Grand Cher; Quincy's playable unit in ACE2

glossary.ja: クインシィ・イッサー
glossary.role: Reclaimer leader at Orphan; Yuu's older sister (real name Iiko Isami); pilots Quincy Grand Cher, later Quincy Baronz
glossary.personality: Harsh, domineering and emotionally unstable. She denies her past as Iiko and resents Yuu, but underneath she is a lonely, confused girl.

glossary.role: Drake Luft's flagship aura battleship; an enemy ship in Operation 25.
The living organic mecha class; it includes both Brain Powerds and Grand Chers. Plural 'Antibodies'.
Class of insect-like Byston Well mecha fielded by the Drake Army and Show's side.
Aura battleship of Bishot Hatta, King of Ku; an enemy ship in Operation 25.
Anti-Orphan battleship (carrier with a pyramid superstructure); base of the Brain Powerd pilots
Protagonist; Holy Warrior (Seisenshi) from Tokyo summoned to Byston Well; defects from Drake Luft to the resistance; pilots Dunbine, later Billbine
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, stubborn young motocross racer who grows into a serious, driven warrior. Has huge Aura Power but struggles to control it. Has unspoken feelings for Marvel.

glossary.role: The people who serve Orphan and pilot Grand Chers to gather its plates; plural 'Reclaimers'
Gigantic sentient alien ship buried under the Pacific; its awakening threatens Earth; base of the Reclaimers
Reclaimer leader at Orphan; Yuu's older sister (real name Iiko Isami); pilots Quincy Grand Cher, later Quincy Baronz
glossary.personality: Harsh, domineering and emotionally unstable. She denies her past as Iiko and resents Yuu, but underneath she is a lonely, confused girl.

glossary.role: Reclaimer ace of Orphan; pilots Jonathan Grand Cher, later Jonathan Baronz; Yuu's rival and the son of Novis Noah's captain Anoa McCormick
glossary.personality: Arrogant, aggressive and taunting, full of resentment toward Yuu and his own mother. Loyal to Baron Maximilian.

glossary.role: The aura energy of a pilot; also the name of a Dunbine-family ability that multiplies attack power for a while (Weapon 6).
Aura battleship of Elle Humm (Kingdom of Lao), armed with the Aura Nova Cannon
Charging a shot; in weapon names (チャージ) suffix.
Main antagonist; Lord of House Luft in the Kingdom of Ah (アの国), who summons Holy Warriors and wages war to unite Byston Well; commands the Will Wipps
glossary.personality: Ambitious, scheming warlord who believes his conquest is justified. Loves his daughter Riml but is blind to the plots around him.

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: ND-001 Nadesico, Nergal's battleship
Life energy of Byston Well that powers aura machines; used alone in lines like オーラの力 / 悪しきオーラ / オーラ光.
Protagonist; Holy Warrior (Seisenshi) from Tokyo summoned to Byston Well; defects from Drake Luft to the resistance; pilots Dunbine, later Billbine
glossary.personality: Hot-blooded, stubborn young motocross racer who grows into a serious, driven warrior. Has huge Aura Power but struggles to control it. Has unspoken feelings for Marvel.

glossary.role: Masked figure who seizes control of Orphan in Jonathan's name and gives him the Baronz; secretly Anoa McCormick, the missing captain of Novis Noah
glossary.personality: Mysterious, theatrical and manipulative. Acts as a mentor to Jonathan, driven by a twisted longing for her estranged son.

glossary.series: Martian Successor Nadesico (TV) / Prince of Darkness
glossary.role: TV: operator/science officer of the Nadesico. PoD: Lieutenant Commander, captain of the Nadesico B ("Electronic Fairy")
glossary.personality: Deadpan, cool, blunt child prodigy (catchphrase "bunch of fools"); slowly warms to the crew

report.translator_summary: Translated all 80 rows of op25_03. Covers Phase 2 battle wrap-up with Nadesico's Phase Transition Cannon firing on Gea Garing, Shot Weapon's bickering, Jonathan Glenn's duel and retreat, Burn Bunnings vs Show, and Yuu vs Quincy Isser; Irene Carrier's tactical briefing regarding Novis Noah's arrival at Orphan and Quincy's Antibody; and Phase 3 mission dialogue escorting Novis Noah.
